Our Philosophy

A Township
with a Soul

NADI — meaning "pulse" in Malay — is more than a development. It is a carefully orchestrated urban ecosystem that integrates medical care, cultural identity, economic vitality, and sustainable living into a single, coherent community.

"A place where the elderly find dignity, youth find opportunity, and every visitor finds a reason to stay."
View Masterplan
01
Medical & Wellness Hub
A 42-acre private hospital anchored by wellness centres, medical showrooms, and integrated health corridors serving the entire Jerantut district and beyond.
02
Inclusive Housing
From affordable low-cost terraces to bungalow estates, NADI provides dignified housing across all income brackets — 2,992 units across 9 residential typologies.
03
Economic Engine
686 industrial lots across light-to-heavy categories, a Pasar Rakyat, hypermarket, MICE centre and hospitality nodes generate a self-sustaining economic ecosystem.
04
Green & Cultural Identity
Ceremonial gardens, the Al-Nadi Mosque, NADI Art Gallery, eco-tourism forest park, and 110+ acres of green space weave cultural heritage into daily life.
05
Smart Connectivity
Jogging trails, walkable boulevards, EV cart parking, a biodigester node, and an observatory tower — infrastructure designed for people, not just vehicles.

Living Experience

Life at NADI

Every amenity, every pathway, every park is designed with intention — to serve the elderly with dignity, inspire youth with opportunity, and delight every visitor.

🏥
Medical Excellence

A 42-acre private hospital with supporting medical showrooms and a wellness centre — making NADI the premier healthcare destination in Pahang's interior.

🌿
Eco Tourism Park

An eco-tourism forest park with jogging trails, an Observatory Tower, eco-pods, and a river corridor — nature integrated into the everyday rhythm of township life.

🎭
Culture & Heritage

Ceremonial gardens, the Al-Nadi Mosque, NADI Gallery, and ceremonial halls preserve and celebrate the rich cultural identity of the Jerantut community.

🛍️
Retail & Commerce

A vibrant mix of boulevard shoplots, Pasar Rakyat, hypermarket, boutique showrooms, and food courts — a fully self-sufficient retail ecosystem.

🏫
Education Hub

Three major educational institutions spanning 81.53 acres — ensuring that NADI is a place where future generations are nurtured and shaped.

🎪
Events & MICE

A dedicated MICE Centre, convention-grade hotel, and stadium position NADI as the regional hub for business events, sports, and community celebrations.

Smart Infrastructure

Built to Last

Robust, future-ready utilities and connectivity systems form the backbone of a thriving, resilient township.

⚡
Electrical Grid

A complete power infrastructure including 1 Main Distribution Substation (PMU, 4.89 ac), 3 Primary Substations (PPU), 7 Electrical Substations, and 3 Double Chamber TNB units.

💧
Water & Sewerage

Two Sewerage Treatment Plants (STP) covering 11.6 acres and 4 detention ponds (5.27 ac) managing stormwater and ensuring environmental compliance.

🛣️
Road Network

380.85 acres of roads — from 100ft main arterials to 40ft internal service roads — providing seamless connectivity throughout the township and to Jalan Temerloh-Jerantut.

🌱
Bio-Digester Node

An integrated organic waste bio-digester reducing landfill dependency and supporting circular economy principles within the township's sustainability framework.

🚒
Satellite Fire Station

A dedicated satellite fire station ensuring rapid emergency response across all zones of the 1,110-acre township.

🚶
Walkable Boulevards

3.21 acres of dedicated pedestrian walkways and 10m walkable boulevards with perimeter planting, jogging trails (2.5m) alongside waterways, and EV cart parking nodes.

Location & Connectivity

Heart of Pahang

Strategically positioned in Mukim Pulau Tawar, District of Jerantut — NADI sits at the gateway to Pahang's ecological heritage, with direct connectivity to major regional arteries.
